test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a surface-to-surface intercontinental range ballistic missile developed by India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agni V.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• India developed a **surface-to-surface intercontinental-range** ballistic missile AGNI V and test fired it on **Oct 27, 2021**.
 
• In India,** Infantry Day **is celebrated on the same day as this event.** **
 
• **On October 27, 2021,** the country commemorated its** 75th Infantry Day.**
 
• Agni-V is equipped with a **three-stage solid-fuelled engine** and uses i**mproved guidance systems **to reach targets with a high degree of accuracy.
 
• The missile was successfully launched from** APJ Abdul Kalam Island, **off the coast of Odisha.
 
• Under the** Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme**, the **Defence Research and Development Organisation **(DRDO) develops the Agni missiles, which are a family of medium to intercontinental-range ballistic missiles.
 
• From Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island, the DRDO tested a **next-generation advanced ballistic missile type **called **Agni-P (Prime).** This is a 'canisterized' surface-to-surface missile with a range of **1,000 to 2,000 kilometres.**
 
• It has a new class of **propulsion and guiding systems** and can strike enemy ships as far as the Indo-Pacific.
 
• The **Man-Portable Antitank Guided Missile **(MPATGM) and the **New Generation Akash Missile **have also been tested by the DRDO (Akash-NG) this year.
